title: jmap-mail-server: #creationId in import/copy/onSuccess
description: Follow-up to JMAP-j7uo (commit 4bb3b5e2). Email/import and Email/copy mailboxIds keys (RFC 8621 §4.8, §4.7) and EmailSubmission/set onSuccessUpdateEmail patches (mailboxIds/#m, RFC 8621 §7.5) still treat '#x' mailbox refs as literal ids; RFC 8620 §5.3 / §3.3 (rfc8620.txt:925-926) says the server replaces references in a create/update. Thread CallContext::created_ids into handle_email_import/handle_email_copy and reuse email.rs resolve_mailbox_id_refs / helpers::resolve_ref.
close_reason: Batch 21 (run wf_18048230-8ff): implemented, adversarially verified; CI green except new cargo-deny advisory RUSTSEC-2026-0387 (crypto-bigint 0.5.5, unrelated to these changes) at 741292f0; beqc spec commits 639dc1d/7787c51 in jmap-chat-spec (not pushed)
